[extensions]
keyUsage = keyEncipherment
subjectAltName = @alt_names

[client_extensions]
keyUsage = keyEncipherment
extendedKeyUsage = clientAuth

[wildcard_extensions]
keyUsage = keyEncipherment
subjectAltName = @wildcard_alt_names

[shortname_extensions]
keyUsage = keyEncipherment
subjectAltName = @shortname_alt_names

[alt_names]
DNS.1 = foreman.example.com
DNS.2 = foreman-ec384.example.com

[wildcard_alt_names]
DNS.1 = *.example.com

[shortname_alt_names]
DNS.1 = foreman

[ec_extensions]
keyUsage = digitalSignature
subjectAltName = @ec_alt_names

[nokeyenc_extensions]
keyUsage = digitalSignature
subjectAltName = @nokeyenc_alt_names

[ec_alt_names]
DNS.1 = foreman-ec384.example.com

[nokeyenc_alt_names]
DNS.1 = foreman-nokeyenc.example.com

[ec_ca_extensions]
keyUsage = digitalSignature
subjectAltName = @ec_ca_alt_names

[ec_sha1_extensions]
keyUsage = digitalSignature
subjectAltName = @ec_sha1_alt_names

[mldsa_extensions]
keyUsage = digitalSignature
subjectAltName = @mldsa_alt_names

# An intermediate CA needs CA:TRUE and keyCertSign to be usable as an issuer.
[intermediate_ca_extensions]
basicConstraints = critical,CA:TRUE
keyUsage = critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign

[ec_ca_alt_names]
DNS.1 = foreman-ec-ca.example.com

[ec_sha1_alt_names]
DNS.1 = foreman-ec-sha1.example.com

[mldsa_alt_names]
DNS.1 = foreman-mldsa.example.com
